contexts: core laboratory for three hospitals and 40 community clinics
about 14,000 critical value calls a year
reading: Delay accumulates where a verified result meets nobody to call: community clinics after closing, outpatients after 17:00 and nights when one technologist also runs the analysers. Call attempts are the visible trace of that search. The data to measure all of this already sit in the call logs, and the definition of the interval matters as much as the analysis.
